data.answer: Skippi's top competitors include Get-A-Way, Opopop, and Hardpops. Get-A-Way specializes in healthy desserts, while BloxSnacks offers fruit-flavored snacks and drinks. Popcorn focuses on food and grocery delivery. Skippi's latest funding round is Seed, raising $2.72M, and its investors include Hems Angels, Hyderabad Angels, Venture Catalysts, Soonicorn Ventures, and Shark Tank India. Skippi's revenue jumped to INR 15.4 Cr in FY23 from INR 2.5 Cr in FY22, expanding its offline presence to over 14,000 outlets. Skippi raised ₹12 crore (approx. $1.4 million) in an extended pre-Series A funding round led by the Dubai-based strategic family offices of Surya.
